problem.title: Maximum Value at a Given Index in a Bounded Array
problem.problemStatement: Construct an array of length n consisting of positive integers such that: Adjacent elements differ by at most 1. The sum of all elements does not exceed maxSum. Return the maximum possible value at the given index.
problem.input: Integer n Integer index Integer maxSum
